# Critique — README Revision

The additions to the README successfully preserved its direct, plain, and confident voice without introducing any corporate or marketing register. We avoided adding redundant explanations of mechanics, instead keeping the V notation and question numbering to concise, one-sentence callouts that point directly to the specification for technical detail. No tensions exist between the updated README and the spec amendments, as both align perfectly on the 1–255 question numbering convention, the V flag behavior, and the reserved status of Pattern 16. The Appendix A pointer is prominently placed under its own distinct "Beyond Static Questions (Appendix A)" subheading right after the Implementer Defined patterns, making it highly visible to any reader scanning the architecture section.
